build_MoE_layer: build a Mixture of Experts layer with configurable num_experts, top_k routing, and optional shared expert
create_MoE_router: create a MoE router parameter that directs input tokens to the top-k selected experts
run_MoE_forward: run the MoE forward pass to route tokens through expert networks and combine outputs
review_MoE_initialization: review the MoE class initialization with inner_dim scaling, auto_scale, and capacity_factor parameters
test_MoE_shared_expert: test the MoE layer with a shared GLUFeedForwardNetwork expert enabled or disabled
